primaryOrdering: Existing Brew ordering; no weight, threshold or band changes. Explore Synergy remains secondary diagnostics.
defectScope: Counts refer to original known diagnostic checks, not all potential semantic gaps or top-20 recovery. New/remaining false positives are listed separately.
precisionMethod: Assistant semantic desk review against frozen Oracle data and full deck composition, not independent human validation. Original pairwise labels and rationales are preserved wherever a candidate remains in the top 20. Debatable is not precision success. No review is a scoring input.
